title: Retained Clothing and Textile Construction

construction_contract.body_ownership: Embodied geometry and motion remain independent of garments.
construction_contract.garment_ownership: Every textile is a detachable asset with its own mesh, material, construction metadata, and provenance.
construction_contract.interaction: Fit is expressed through skinning, named attachment zones, collision-zone metadata, and secondary textile joints.
construction_contract.scene_assembly: Character scenes reference garment assets rather than baking clothing into the body mesh.
construction_contract.decor_reuse: Textile assets may be instanced in detached or architectural-decoration states without changing their source identity.

acceptance: The canonical GLB reopens with embedded textures and no external URIs.
Body and garment mesh ownership are disjoint.
At least three wearable garment families and one textile-decor family are retained.
Each garment carries panel, seam, material, fit, attachment, collision, and provenance metadata.
Body motion and secondary textile motion target different retained joints.
The package exposes dressed, body-only, and detached-gallery verification states.
Each garment is also exported as a standalone GLB.

not_claimed: CLO or Marvelous Designer native project export
